text: Rohan has his knee operation on 14 November at the Royal Free. He's been told to expect six weeks on crutches and no driving, which he's not taking well because he only just started at the new firm in September. His sister is coming up to help for the first few days. Remind me to drop some food round the day after he gets home, and maybe lend him the shower stool.
Suzanne's housewarming is on the 3rd of December. New place is a terraced house in Walthamstow, and she says the garden is a disaster.

Laura's dad passed away on Sunday. The funeral is on 28 October at the crematorium, with a gathering at the cricket club afterwards. She sounded completely flattened on the phone and kept apologising for crying. Her brother is flying back from Singapore the day before. She said the hardest part is clearing his flat, which has to be done by the end of November.
Coffee with Chloe. She was made redundant last Friday after nine years at the agency. Trying to be upbeat but clearly struggling.
Yosef and Marisol are having people over for dinner on 9/11. They asked me to bring dessert, so I'm making the lemon tart.
Need to ring Aneesh on 22 October to see how his gallbladder op went. It's that morning, so leave it until the evening.

Chen's mum is in hospital in Taipei with pneumonia. He's flying out on the 5th and doesn't know when he'll be back. His manager has been decent about it and given him compassionate leave, but he's worried about money because the flights were nearly a thousand pounds at short notice. He said his mum keeps telling everyone she's fine.
Caitlin and Nikolai have split up. She's moving back in with her parents for now. Don't forget to message her at the weekend.
Dentist moved to 17/11 at 9:15.
Aoife mentioned she's been doing pottery classes on Tuesday nights and wants her own wheel eventually.
Valentina had her scan on Monday and everything looks fine. Huge relief all round.
Lior's leaving drinks were meant to be on the 30th of October but they've been called off because half the team has flu.
Bilal invited me to his 40th on 15 November, at the Italian place on the high street. I've already said yes. He'd love a decent bottle of mezcal, according to his wife.
Bethany's cat Pepper had surgery on her jaw yesterday. Bethany was in bits about it. Must text her tomorrow to ask how Pepper's eating.

Anya is nervous about her hip replacement on 2 December. She keeps asking me what recovery is really like, and I don't think the leaflet from the hospital helped. Her husband works away a lot, so she's worried about the stairs and the dog. I said I'd visit the week after and take her to the physio appointment on the 16th if she still can't drive.
Siobhan's gran died in the night. Funeral is in Cork, probably the following Thursday. She's going over the day before with her brother Sam.
Ann is vegetarian now, and apparently has been since the summer. Worth remembering for the 12 December dinner.

Long call with Magda tonight. Her partner Tobi lost his job at the warehouse at the end of September, and they've had to cancel the trip to Kraków they'd booked for 8 November. She says he's sleeping badly and won't talk about it, and she's worried about him. I should invite them both round for a quiet dinner one evening next week, nothing fancy.
Rana's daughter starts her chemo on 4 November. Rana is taking the first week off work to be with her.
Remind me to ask Dalia how the hen do went. It was this weekend in Bath.
Hassan had his cataract surgery on the 19th. He's not allowed to drive for a fortnight, so I'm taking him to the follow-up on 2 November.
Sofia and her husband are throwing a party for their twins' first birthday on 26 October. Bring something for the babies, ideally not plastic.
Pick up the dry cleaning before Saturday and book the car in for its MOT.
Rosa is recovering well from her C-section. Baby Mateo is feeding much better now. Send flowers to the house this week.
Tariq said his brother Ahmed is getting engaged on the 1st of November. The whole family is going over to Manchester for it.

Pooja's divorce came through last week. She says she's relieved more than anything, but she's not sleeping well and the house feels very empty now the kids are with their dad every other weekend. She's thinking about getting a lodger to help with the mortgage. We should have her over for Sunday lunch soon.
Amara has a consultant appointment on 6/11 about the migraines. She's been getting them three or four times a week.
Bumped into Suzanne Morris at the station. Her husband had a minor heart attack last month and is doing cardiac rehab twice a week now. She seemed tired.
Chloe has an interview on Thursday for a project manager job at the council. First one since the redundancy and she's really anxious. Text her good luck that morning.
Mrs Fischer next door is home from hospital after her fall. Her son is staying with her until the 10th.
Laura's dad's funeral was today. Beautiful service. I should check in with her in a few days, once everyone else has gone home.
Housewarming at Rohan and Pooja's on 23 November. They've finally bought the flat in Leith.
Aneesh says the op went fine and he's already walking about. He's back at work on 3 November, which seems too soon to me.
Marisol hates surprise parties. Do not let Yosef plan one for her 50th.
Nikolai has been offered a voluntary redundancy package. He has until 31 October to decide and is leaning towards taking it.

Dinner with Caitlin. She's doing better than I expected after the breakup, and she's signed up for a half marathon in April, which is very unlike her. Her sister Bethany is coming down to stay with her for a week from 14 November, and they're planning to redecorate the flat together so it stops feeling like his. She's also back on the climbing wall on Wednesdays.
Uncle Bilal is having his second hip done on 20 January. Auntie wants us all at the house the weekend before.
Don't forget to sign the card for Chen and pass it round before Friday. His father's funeral is on the 25th.
Gym, then food shop, then sort out the boiler insurance. Nothing else this weekend.
Valentina's engagement party has been called off. She and Lior broke up a week before it was supposed to happen. She doesn't want people asking about it.
Siobhan is back from Cork. She said the wake went on until two in the morning and her brother Sam gave a lovely eulogy.
Anya's surgery got postponed to 9 December because of a bed shortage. She's frustrated but taking it well.
Got a voice note from Dalia. Her dog Biscuit was hit by a car and had to be put down on Tuesday. Order a little paw print frame for her.
Hassan Haddad from work is retiring on 18 December. There's a lunch for him that day and I'm on the collection.
Rana's mother-in-law moved in with them after her stroke. The house is quite crowded now and Rana is exhausted.
Sofia mentioned she's been collecting vintage Pyrex for years. Good to know for Christmas.
Tobi starts a new job on 17 November, driving for a delivery firm. Magda says he's much brighter already.
Amara's migraine appointment went well. They've given her a new preventative and she starts it the day after her next period.
Rosa invited us to the christening on 7 December. It's at St Anne's at eleven with lunch afterwards at her mum's.
Ann had a mole removed on Wednesday. Results should be back about a week after. Remember to ask her what they said.

Big dinner at Tariq's on the 2nd to celebrate the engagement. Ahmed and his fiancée will be there, plus Tariq's parents, who are coming down from Manchester the day before and staying until the Tuesday. Tariq is cooking his biryani and asked me to bring a salad. Ahmed apparently wants a proper espresso machine for the new flat, so maybe a few of us could chip in.
Pooja told me she's thinking of retraining as a nurse. She'd need to do an access course first.
Called Mum. Her friend Magda is having keyhole surgery next month and Mum is going with her to the hospital.
Remember to call Aoife on the 8th, the day before her dad's bypass. She's going to be a wreck.
Chen Dubois said the restructure at his firm is done. He kept his job, but his whole team was let go. He feels awful about it.
Bethany's leaving do is on 13 November at the Fox. She got the job in Bristol and moves down the following weekend.
Renew passport. It runs out on 2 March.
Laura messaged to say thanks for the flowers. She's going back to work on Monday but only part time for the first month.
Yosef's son is having his tonsils out on 28/10. Yosef has taken the day off and the day after. Must message him that evening.

Lovely evening at Suzanne's housewarming. Her neighbours Rosa and Sam came too. Suzanne said the boiler packed in two days before and she nearly cancelled. Nikolai left early because he has his sleep study the next morning, which he's dreading. Remind me to text Nikolai afterwards to see how it went.
